test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-3) Official Paper (Held On: 17 June 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: M. N, O, P and R are sitting around a circular table. All are facing towards the centre of the table. M is seated second to the right and N is seated third to the right of O. P is seated second to the left of N. Who is seated between N and O when counted from the left of O?
solution:
**Friends : **M. N, O, P and R. All are facing towards the centre of the table.

1) M is seated second to the right and N is seated third to the right of O.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1cd3f455284a2047a00e0168cfff502f970913258cf1924b7d74dbfc16b76404.png] 

2) P is seated second to the left of N.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0228ada2e56b75483c6ab80bc79cb9c87c1cc5b1c37da80b3bee2e00c546ccc4.png] 

Clearly, when counted from the left of O. R is seated between N and O.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only R".**
